sections.p: Every day you get three missions from the areas you chose. How long they run follows the time you said you have: with 15 minutes all three are short; with 30, two are short and one takes real focus; with 45, one is short and two take real focus; with an hour or more, intensity decides, and Push me adds a fourth. They're picked to fit your answers, what you're working toward and this week's focus. A day runs from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM, so a late night counts as the day it started.

Don't want one? Swap it before you prove it, and you get another mission from the same area when one fits today. One swap a day, three with UNSETLD+. A mission you swap stays away for a week, or three weeks after you swap it a third time in a month. An everyday habit like Study for 30 Minutes or Complete Your Workout comes back after a couple of days.

Do the mission for real, then prove it in the app. Each mission says how: a photo, a photo before and after, the focus timer and then a photo, or the timer on its own. Photos are taken with the camera in the app in the last 30 minutes, and a photo can only count once.
The checks run on this phone. They look at when and how the photo was taken and whether the timer ran to the end, never at what's in a photo. Nobody reviews your photos and no AI looks at them.
Each proven mission earns the points shown on it, once. Longer missions earn more. Points come only from proven missions.
list: Perfect day, every mission proven: 15 more.

sections.p: Your streak is the days in a row you proved at least one mission. Today counts once you prove one. Until then, yesterday's streak stands.
Miss a day and an Off Day covers it, so the streak keeps going. You earn one every 7 days you show up. You can bank two.
The points from each mission add to its area's level, so you can see where the work is going. Achievements mark your first mission, your first perfect day, 7 days, 30 missions and more.
Photos stay on this phone. They're deleted after 30 days unless you choose 1 year or Keep under Proof photos in You. The mission, its points and your streak stay.

Points trade for rewards at unsetld.com, like a discount on one order. Taking one spends its points. What's on offer, what each one costs and its limits can change with each collection: Rewards shows what's open now, and All rewards shows each one with its limits.

Status is separate from points: it counts the days you prove at least one mission, and spending points never lowers it. Each status tier opens at a number of those days. Status, in Rewards, shows the tiers on offer and how far you are from each.
Once early access is open, if 14 days pass without a proven mission, it pauses until you prove a mission on 7 more days. Your count, points and milestones stay.

One code per order. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code, and exclude the 365 piece. Each reward's own limits, such as how many you can take each collection, the most it takes off or a minimum order, are shown with it in All rewards, and a status tier's are on its page.
Points and status come only from proven missions. UNSETLD+ doesn't change them, and none of it is for sale.
To use a reward or access you need a free account, made with Sign in with Apple, so unsetld.com can hold your place. Your photos stay on this phone.
For US residents 13 and over. If you're under 18, get a parent's or guardian's OK before you place an order.
Points and status are earned only by proving missions in the app. They can't be bought, and UNSETLD+ doesn't change them.

Each mission proven in the app earns the points shown on it once, from 5 to 25 depending on how long it takes, and 15 more when every mission in the day is proven. Proof must be your own: a photo of that mission taken with the camera in the app, or, for a timer mission, the in-app timer run to the end. Points from earlier versions of the app carry over. We may remove points earned through misuse, such as proof that isn't of the mission.

Points can be traded for the rewards shown in the app, such as a discount on one order at unsetld.com. The rewards on offer, the points each one costs, their dates and their limits (how many you can take each collection, the most a code takes off, any minimum order and how long a code works) are shown in the app and may change with each collection. Codes are single use and only valid at unsetld.com.

Status counts the days you prove at least one mission. The status tiers on offer, the number of those days each one opens at, what each one includes and its limits are shown in the app and may change with each collection.

No cash value. Not transferable. Points, codes and status can't be sold, bought or exchanged for money. One code per order. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code, and exclude the 365 piece.
Once early access is open, if 14 days pass without a proven mission, it pauses until you prove a mission on 7 more days. Your count, points and milestones stay.
We may change or end the program with 30 days' notice in the app. Points already earned can still be traded for 30 days after it ends.

UNSETLD gives you daily missions, a camera to prove them, points, a streak, levels, plans, reminders and rewards. It isn't medical, financial or professional advice. Do missions within your limits, and swap any that don't suit you.

UNSETLD+ is sold through Apple as an auto-renewing subscription (yearly or monthly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula) also applies.
Rewards and UNSETLD status have their own terms, in You and on the Rewards screen.
The missions and everything else in the app are original to UNSETLD. Your proof photos are yours and stay on your phone.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com
Your missions, your answers about you, your streak, points and proof photos live on your iPhone. There are no ads, no tracking and no analytics SDKs.

Purchases: Apple processes payments, and RevenueCat (our subscription provider) receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase history so UNSETLD+ works across your devices. Time check: the app asks unsetld.com for the current date so streaks stay honest. No identifier is sent. Config: the app reads small public files from unsetld.com to know whether rewards are on, which rewards and status tiers are offered and when drops open.

The camera is used only when you prove a mission. Photos are saved inside the app on this iPhone and the app never uploads them. Each photo is re-encoded when it's saved, which removes its metadata, including location. Photos are deleted after 30 days unless you choose 1 year or Keep under Proof photos in You; the mission and its points stay. Like other app files, they can be part of your own iPhone backup.

Proof is checked on this phone: that a timer ran to the end, and that the photos were taken just now, in the right order and after the timer, and weren't used before. The checks don't look at what's in a photo. There is no facial recognition, no AI and no one reviewing your photos.
Missions never ask for photos of your face or body, other people, IDs, addresses, bank details, grades, medical information or private conversations, or for your location. There is no public feed.

Your answers (school, work, gym, a business or project, what you're learning, your age range), what you're working toward, this week's focus and the areas you chose only decide which missions you get. They stay on your phone.

sections.h: If you sign in for rewards or access
sections.p: Signing in with Apple is optional and only needed to use rewards and access. We receive an Apple user ID and, if you choose, a private relay email. We store the days you proved a mission and each day's number of proven missions and points (dates and numbers only, never photos) so we can hold your place and issue single-use codes. We also keep a token from Apple so we can end the Sign in with Apple link when you delete your account. Nothing else.
Mission reminders and the focus timer alert are local notifications scheduled on your phone. Drop alerts are separate, off by default, and only on if you turn them on.
Links to unsetld.com open in Safari, which is covered by that site's privacy policy.

Delete the app to remove its data and proof photos from your phone. A copy of your record (missions, points and streak, never photos) is kept in your iPhone's Keychain so a reinstall picks up where you left off; iOS can keep it after the app is deleted, and it's never uploaded. To delete an account, open You in the app, then Account, then Delete account. We remove the account and what we hold for it, and end the Sign in with Apple link. You can also email unsetldclothing@gmail.com from the address on the account.
UNSETLD is for people 13 and older. We don't knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13. If you think a child under 13 has signed in, email us and we'll delete the account.
